lines: Desh mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand
couplets.en: Back home, the moon must have risen.

lines: Hum to hain pardes mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand
Apni raat ki chhat par kitna tanha hoga chaand
couplets.en: Here we are far from home, and how alone the moon must be above the rooftop of our night.

lines: Hum to hain pardes mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand
couplets.en: We are far from home, where the moon must have risen by now.

lines: Jin aankhon mein kajal ban kar tairi kaali raat
Jin aankhon mein kajal ban kar tairi kaali raat
couplets.en: In those eyes, the dark night floated like kohl.

lines: Jin aankhon mein kajal ban kar tairi kaali raat
Un aankhon mein aansu ka ek qatra hoga chaand
couplets.en: In the eyes where the dark night floated like kohl, the moon must be a single tear.

lines: Hum to hain pardes mein, desh mein nikla hoga chaand

lines: Aangan waale neem mein ja kar atka hoga chaand
couplets.en: The moon must have caught in the branches of the courtyard neem.

lines: Chaand bina har din yun beeta, jaise yug beete
couplets.en: Without the moon, each day passed like an age.

lines: Mere bina kis haal mein hoga, kaisa hoga chaand
couplets.en: How must the moon be faring without me?
